# state.md format

Edit in place. Update whatever has changed; remove anything no longer true. Do not append history.

---

```md
# State
_Last updated: YYYY-MM-DD HHMM_

## Current focus

## What's working

## In progress

## Known issues

## Next actions
1.
2.
3.

## Active plan
docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD HHMM Plan - Subject.md

## Recent logs
- docs/log/YYYY-MM-DD HHMM Subject.md — one line summary
```
